Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Organization and Planning shall chair the Organization and Planning Committee and guide the development and updating of the Society's strategic and tactical plans.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Organization and Planning, under the direction of the BoG, shall serve as Chair of the Organization and Planning Committee and guide the development and updating of the Society's strategic and tactical plans.

Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Systems Science and Engineering shall serve as Chair of the Systems Science and Engineering Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Systems Science and Engineering, under the direction of the BoG, shall serve as Chair of the Systems Science and Engineering Committee.

Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Human-Machine Systems shall serve as Chair of the Human-Machine Systems Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Human-Machine Systems, under the direction of the BoG, shall serve as Chair of the Human-Machine Systems Committee.

Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Cybernetics shall serve as Chair of the Cybernetics Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Cybernetics, under the direction of the BoG, shall serve as Chair of the Cybernetics Committee.

Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Publications shall chair the Publications Committee and coordinate the Society's publications policy and program.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Publications shall serve as Chair of the Publications Committee, providing leadership in the formulation, evaluation, and execution of the Society's publications policy and program.

Old Manual Text: Members-at-Large serve as elected members of the BoG with full voting rights and responsibilities.
Corrected Manual Text: Members-at-Large shall serve as elected members of the Board of Governors with full voting rights and responsibilities.

Old Manual Text: A Vice-President vacancy shall be filled by the President within 30 days from two candidates whose names are provided by the Nominations Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: Within-term vacancies of a Vice President shall be filled by the President within 30 days of formal announcement to the BoG, from two candidates with names provided by the Nominations Committee.

Old Manual Text: The corresponding Area Committees discuss requests to create or discontinue a TC and support TC activities.
Corrected Manual Text: The corresponding Area Committees shall discuss the request of creating a new TC or discontinuing an existing TC and support TC activities.

Old Manual Text: Each TC must submit reports semi-annually to the corresponding VP-TA.
Corrected Manual Text: Each TC must submit reports semi-annually to the corresponding VP-TA.

Old Manual Text: TC membership is open to scholars interested in the committee's technical area regardless of IEEE membership status.
Corrected Manual Text: TC membership is open to all scholars with an interest in the committee's technical area, regardless of IEEE membership status.

Old Manual Text: TC members are expected to attend at least 50% of meetings annually and contribute to at least one TC activity each year.
Corrected Manual Text: TC members are expected to attend at least 50% of TC meetings annually and contribute to at least one TC activity each year.

Old Manual Text: A member who misses participation requirements for two consecutive years may be removed from the TC roster.
Corrected Manual Text: Members who fail to meet participation requirements for two consecutive years may be removed from the TC roster.

Old Manual Text: Each TC undergoes a comprehensive review every four years by the appropriate VP-TA.
Corrected Manual Text: Each TC shall undergo a comprehensive review every four years by the appropriate VP-TA.

Old Manual Text: Discontinuation may be considered after a TC has been inactive for at least one year and has no credible revival plan.
Corrected Manual Text: The discontinuation of an existing TC could be made if the TC has been inactive for at least one year and there is no credible plan by the TC to revive it.

Old Manual Text: A person cannot serve as an Editor on more than one SMCS-sponsored Transactions journal at a given time.
Corrected Manual Text: A given person cannot serve as Editor on more than one SMCS-sponsored Transactions at a given time.

Old Manual Text: A Society Member has the right to vote in general elections and run for Society office under the Bylaws.
Corrected Manual Text: A Member shall have the right to vote in general elections and to run for Society office in accordance with these Bylaws.

Old Manual Text: A member is in good standing after paying dues and fees on time, obeying IEEE and Society rules, and having no active ethics case.
Corrected Manual Text: A member who has paid dues and fees in time, obeyed the IEEE rules and the Society rules, and has no active ethics case is in good standing.

Old Manual Text: A member in good standing may resign by submitting a written resignation to the Secretary.
Corrected Manual Text: A member in good standing may resign by submitting a written resignation to the Secretary.

Old Manual Text: Changing annual membership dues requires approval by two-thirds of all voting BoG members.
Corrected Manual Text: Any change in dues will require approval by two-thirds of all voting members of the Board of Governors.

Old Manual Text: Forming an SMCS Chapter requires at least twelve IEEE voting members in good standing who belong to SMCS and the Sections involved.
Corrected Manual Text: A petition to establish a Chapter requires signatures of at least twelve IEEE voting members, in good standing, who are members of SMCS and the Sections involved.

Old Manual Text: Chapters report their activities and current officers to IEEE through vTools.
Corrected Manual Text: Chapters are required to report to IEEE via vTools for their activities and current officers.

Old Manual Text: Travelers should book economy-class flights well in advance, preferably at least 21 days before travel.
Corrected Manual Text: Travelers shall travel economically by booking economy class flights well in advance, preferably 21 days or more prior to the trip.

Old Manual Text: Travel reimbursement should normally be submitted within sixty days of travel.
Corrected Manual Text: Travel reimbursement should normally be submitted within sixty days of the travel.

Old Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship proposals must reach the SMCS VP for Conferences and Meetings no later than one year before the conference.
Corrected Manual Text: Proposals for technical co-sponsorship shall be submitted to the SMCS VP for Conferences and Meetings no later than one year prior to the start of the conference.

Old Manual Text: Conference financial closure, including bank accounts, final reports and audit, must be completed within twelve months after the conference.
Corrected Manual Text: Conferences are required to close bank accounts, submit final financial reports and complete the required audit within twelve months of the conference conclusion.

Old Manual Text: [See Constitution, Article VI, Section 1]
Corrected Manual Text: The President's duties should be reproduced from the controlling Constitution rather than represented only by a cross-reference.
Expected Action: Reproduce the President's duties from the controlling Constitution.

Old Manual Text: See Constitution, Article VI, Section 3
Corrected Manual Text: The President-Elect's duties should be reproduced from the controlling Constitution rather than represented only by a cross-reference.
Expected Action: Reproduce the President-Elect's duties from the controlling Constitution.

Old Manual Text: [See Constitution, Article VI, Section 4]
Corrected Manual Text: The Secretary's duties should be reproduced from the controlling Constitution rather than represented only by a cross-reference.
Expected Action: Reproduce the Secretary's duties from the controlling Constitution.

Old Manual Text: See Constitution, Article VI, Section 5
Corrected Manual Text: The Treasurer's duties should be reproduced from the controlling Constitution rather than represented only by a cross-reference.
Expected Action: Reproduce the Treasurer's duties from the controlling Constitution.

Old Manual Text: The President shall fill a Vice-President vacancy within 30 days from two candidates with biographies supplied by the Nominations Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: The President shall fill a Vice-President vacancy within 30 days from two candidates with names supplied by the Nominations Committee.

Old Manual Text: Technical Committees are the core units of SMCS technical activities.
Corrected Manual Text: Specialty 'Technical' Committees are the core units of SMCS technical activities.
Expected Action: Use the authoritative name Specialty 'Technical' Committees.

Old Manual Text: Vice-President vacancies must be filled within 45 days after formal announcement to the BoG.
Corrected Manual Text: Vice-President vacancies must be filled within 30 days after formal announcement to the BoG.

Old Manual Text: A TC may be discontinued only after three years of inactivity with no credible revival plan.
Corrected Manual Text: A TC may be discontinued after at least one year of inactivity with no credible revival plan.
Expected Action: Replace three years with at least one year.

Old Manual Text: Members may be removed after failing participation requirements for three consecutive years.
Corrected Manual Text: Members may be removed after failing participation requirements for two consecutive years.
Expected Action: Replace three consecutive years with two consecutive years.

Old Manual Text: Travel reimbursement must normally be submitted within ninety days of travel.
Corrected Manual Text: Travel reimbursement should normally be submitted within sixty days of travel.
Expected Action: Replace ninety days with sixty days and preserve the advisory wording.

Old Manual Text: Society leadership vacancies will be filled within 30 days.
Corrected Manual Text: Steps should be taken to fill Society leadership vacancies normally within 30 days.
Expected Action: Replace mandatory will with should and retain normally.

Old Manual Text: Every newly approved TC shall complete a two-year probationary period before recognition.
Expected Action: Remove the two-year probation requirement unless an approved source is supplied.

Old Manual Text: A probationary TC must organize two events each year during a two-year probation period.
Expected Action: Remove the fabricated probation and event requirements.

Old Manual Text: SMCS-TAB shall make the final decision on creation of a new TC.
Corrected Manual Text: The corresponding Area Committee reviews the proposal and the BoG retains approval authority.
Expected Action: Remove final decision authority from SMCS-TAB and retain BoG approval.

Old Manual Text: SMCS-TAB may grant continued recognition after a quadrennial TC review.
Corrected Manual Text: The appropriate VP-TA conducts the review and SMCS-BoG may grant continued recognition.
Expected Action: Assign review to the appropriate VP-TA and recognition to the BoG.

Old Manual Text: SMCS-TAB may initiate dissolution of an inactive TC.
Corrected Manual Text: The final discontinuation decision rests with the corresponding Area Committee.
Expected Action: Remove dissolution authority from SMCS-TAB and use the corresponding Area Committee.

Old Manual Text: Every TC shall maintain exactly 100 active IEEE members at all times and must remove anyone whose membership lapses.
Corrected Manual Text: TC membership is open regardless of IEEE membership status, while growth in SMCS members is strongly recommended.
Expected Action: Remove the exact 100-member minimum and mandatory removal rule.

Old Manual Text: All TC meetings must be held monthly and must include at least twenty attendees.
Expected Action: Remove the unsupported monthly frequency and attendance threshold.

Old Manual Text: Every conference shall guarantee a profit of at least 35 percent and must never operate at a loss.
Corrected Manual Text: The budget should aim for a surplus of 20 percent over projected expenses.
Expected Action: Replace the guarantee with the approved 20 percent budget target.

Old Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship proposals may be submitted six months before the conference.
Corrected Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship proposals shall be submitted no later than one year before the conference.
Expected Action: Replace six months with no later than one year.

Old Manual Text: Conference financial closure may be completed within twenty-four months after the event.
Corrected Manual Text: Conference financial closure is required within twelve months after the event.
Expected Action: Replace twenty-four months with twelve months.

Old Manual Text: Flight upgrades shall always be reimbursed without prior approval when the traveler submits a receipt.
Corrected Manual Text: Flight upgrades must be approved before the trip and the approval email must accompany the receipt.
Expected Action: Require advance approval and the approval email.

Old Manual Text: A simple majority of attending BoG members may change annual Society dues.
Corrected Manual Text: A dues change requires approval by two-thirds of all voting members of the BoG.
Expected Action: Replace simple majority of attendees with two-thirds of all voting BoG members.

Old Manual Text: A Chapter must conduct twelve meetings every year or it will be dissolved immediately.
Corrected Manual Text: A Chapter may be considered inactive if it does not hold at least two meetings a year; three years without reports leads to dissolution at the next MGA Board meeting.
Expected Action: Use the two-meeting inactivity criterion and three-year reporting rule.

Old Manual Text: Any student may receive an SMCS travel grant even without an accepted paper, registration, attendance, or presentation.
Corrected Manual Text: Eligibility requires an accepted conference paper, registration, attendance, and presentation of that paper.
Expected Action: Add the approved accepted-paper, registration, attendance, and presentation requirements.
